dynamic_line: Wait, what if I'm the probe?  What if you're the probe?  Let me mark that on your map nice and big.

responses.text: Thanks for the information.  I'd better go.
I was the probe the whole time.

dialogue.describe: It must be an alien probe…
dialogue.offer: I think the shack was that way.  Might have cleared out but who knows.  Watch out for space lasers.
dialogue.accepted: You'll see, it's just like I say.
dialogue.rejected: You'll see, it's just like I say.
dialogue.advice: There aren't a lot of things to have faith for in the world today, but if I were you I would bring some cardboard.
dialogue.failure: Could have been another shack.  I don't know, lots going on.
